body:
Lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-17). On 11-17 the Engram restart-set binary (eecabd6a) was installed at 06:35Z, ahead of a 06:50Z "restart now". Greg was not available, and by 13:45Z the restart still hadn't happened. From install on, every NEW engram CLI process refused with projection_repair_required, so Engram writes were blocked for about 7 h. The Merger then restored the old binary 954dfe2d.

RULE: never pre-stage an install whose new binary refuses work before the restart, such as one needing a projection repair or cutover. The order is:
1. Greg tells Asistant he is available.
2. Within about 15 min, the installs go in and Central is confirmed quiet.
3. "restart now" goes out for an IMMEDIATE restart.
4. The post-restart repair runs.
A TermAl install that only replaces target/release/termal.exe and blocks nothing may still be pre-staged.
